source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: _addConversation checks the addContact return value and avoids selecting or attaching buddy contact state when no item was created. Preserve that absent-item boundary when changing chat restoration or contacts. A core event alone is not proof that a UI item exists. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Treat unsuccessful chat contact creation as an absent UI item
